## `neuro.int32Array.of`

Static method on `Int32Array`. Variadic items live under `items`.

> Returns a new array from a set of elements.

## Signatures

```ts
of(input: { items: number[]; prompt?: string }): Promise<Int32Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Int32Array.of` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
